diagnosis: Customer's client is not honoring the Retry-After header on 429 responses. Need to verify whether they're using a custom HTTP client or a standard library that may require explicit configuration to respect retry headers.
reply: When you receive a 429 response, a Retry-After header is included that specifies the cooldown period in seconds. Please ensure your client is configured to read and honor this header before retrying. You may also want to add jitter to avoid thundering-herd issues when multiple clients hit the same constraint.
